While Willet self-reports aversion to open-ended generative work, its Creative Generation score (82.7) is meaningfully higher than Lapwing's (78.8), exceeding the 2-point variance threshold. Additionally, this task has reasonably clear completion criteria (40 names each, specified category), aligning with Willet's preference for well-specified requests.
